instruction.text: Look at the pictures. Select the animal that does not fit with the rest?

correct.text: Well done! Out of these six animals, the red squirrel is the only animal that does not live in the Arctic.

atoms.b: The Arctic is located at the ((++North South)) Pole.
It is an extreme habitat with an average temperature in winter of around ((++-30°C 20°C)).
Therefore, the animals living there ((++have have_not)) adapted their bodies to survive in this freezing environment.
Since it is so cold, you ((++won’t_find_any will_find_many)) trees.
Instead, there is a lot of frozen land and many ice caps. However, climate change is affecting the Arctic and causing the ice to ((++melt solidify)).

hint.text: Most animals living in the arctic have white fur to better disguise themselves in their snowy habitat.

atoms.a: What do these animals have in common?
b: All of them have very big ears.
All of them only eat snow.

atoms.a: Why do they have white fur?
b: The white fur is easier to clean.
++The white fur works like an invisibility cloak in the snow.

correct.text: The white fur is one of the animals’ adaptations to the Arctic habitat. This way, they are less visible to predators.

trainers.instruction: These two hares live in different habitats. Look at the picture and compare the specialisations of their bodies. Then choose the correct answers to fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: The Arctic hare has several adaptations in its body in order to better survive in its extreme ((++habitat city)). For example, the white fur helps it to ((++blend_in stand_out)) with the white and snowy surroundings.

The ((++ears eyes)) and body of the Arctic hare are a lot ((++smaller bigger)) compared to other hares. This is so that the hare can keep more ((++warmth cold)) inside its body, as less of its body is exposed to the cold.
